data.long_meaning: From the Old German 'fol' meaning 'people' and 'beraht' meaning 'bright, famous'. This name signifies a wealthy warrior. The name Folberth carries the meaning “Wealthy in battle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Folberth usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy in battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
